Hi Sam — thanks for the clear asks. Short answers up front:

• Audit period: Our upcoming Type II report covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31 (the opinion will explicitly state the period).
• Bridge letter: Yes — we provide a standard bridge letter for timing gaps; we can also produce a short tailored bridge that references your contract effective date.
• Transfer options: S3 presigned links (preferred for larger artifacts), encrypted Google Drive with customer-managed keys, and SFTP for customers who require it.

Below is a compact intake brief, delegation-ready templates, and attachments we typically provide. If you want, I can hand this to your ops team as a single ZIP via an S3 presigned link.

Intake brief (what we typically need up front) — minimal starter pack:
- Signed NDA or access acknowledgement (if required by your legal)
- One-line point of contact and email for evidence questions
- Preferred transfer method (S3 presigned / Drive / SFTP)
- Priority artifact list (see matrix below)
- Any redaction rules you require (PII, customer IDs)

Priority artifact matrix (minimal) — quick guide:
- Policies: InfoSec policy bundle (SSO, access management, change mgmt) — 1 doc each
- Logs: Redacted system logs (sample 7–14 day window) — csv or gz (we prefer redacted samples)
- Configs: Firewall / VPC config snapshot — pdf or text
- Access lists: Admin roster and 90-day access review output — redacted 
- Evidence of controls: Screenshots or auditor-friendly exports (MFA enforcement, IAM roles)

Standard bridge letter options:
- Standard: short paragraph confirming control continuity and describing the gap period
- Tailored: includes specific contract dates and any mitigating compensating controls

One-line delegation templates (copy/paste for your ops/security team):
- "Please share redacted SSO policy (pdf) and a 7-day redacted auth log sample via S3 presigned link to security@redwood-inference.com."
- "We need an admin access roster (redacted) and the latest access review export — upload to the Drive folder: <your chosen link>."

Attachments (we included two sample redacted artifacts below): redacted_acme_sample_logs.csv, redacted_sso_policy.pdf (we can provide more if you prefer).

If the above looks good I'll: (1) create an S3 presigned bundle for immediate upload, (2) share a bridge-letter draft that you can attach to your procurement packet, and (3) provide three one-line reply templates (delegation / vendor-ops / legal).

Thanks — Hannah
